scopeTexts.text: Import question sets into your courses and topics, and see your courses, folders and sets to do it.

Add, change and delete your courses, topics, folders and sets, as you can in QBank: make and rename them, move sets, replace or restore a set's questions, and set up exam and study pages. Anything it deletes goes to Recently deleted, where you can bring it back for 30 days. It never answers questions for you.
